title: Kirby Problem 1.23
exact_target: Determine whether instanton web homology counts three-edge colorings, and whether the planar foam counterpart is nonzero for every bridgeless planar trivalent graph.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2682 (KP-1.23). CC BY 4.0.
